summary: Defines the ResearchCommandService contract and live layer for the research knowledge-vault command group, but also inlines all eight subcommand pipeline implementations (capture, history-sift, repo-card, notion-pull, cognify, digest, daily, status), their private DuckDB row schemas, markdown card/digest rendering, a git-commit process runner, eight public use-case wrapper effects, and the CLI help index.

concerns.name: Service contract + tag
concerns.description: The Context.Service shape, tag class, and the requirements union that every impl threads through. Lines 91-183.

concerns.name: Service wiring / live layer
concerns.description: Captures the runtime context once and adapts each impl into the service record; the default Layer. Lines 1069-1117.

concerns.name: Firecrawl scrape adapter
concerns.description: Opt-in service resolution (Effect.serviceOption(Firecrawl) with Layer.build fallback) plus untyped-document field extraction. Lines 185-218.

concerns.name: Catalog persistence helpers + private row schemas
concerns.description: DuckDB catalog plumbing: state-dir creation, card+seen-url upsert batch, seen-URL loading, and three ad-hoc S.Class row schemas with decoders. Lines 220-379, 686-697, 805-817.

concerns.name: Subcommand pipeline implementations
concerns.description: Eight *Impl Effect.fn pipelines plus their mutable collection accumulators (SiftCollection, RepoCardCollection) and collectors. Lines 232-303, 383-490, 494-619, 623-684, 700-803, 826-900, 941-1006, 1010-1067.

concerns.name: Markdown card/digest rendering
concerns.description: Pure string assembly interleaved with the impls: history stub bodies, clone/star repo card bodies, notion x-post bodies, digest note lines, and wikilink formatting.

concerns.name: Git process execution
concerns.description: commitVault spawns git add/diff/commit via ChildProcess.make with exit-code filtering — the only ChildProcess use in the file. Lines 904-939.

concerns.name: Public use-case wrappers
concerns.description: Eight thin service-delegating Effect.fn exports plus the resolveResearchVaultRoot re-export alias, each with heavy docgen JSDoc; these are what Research.command.ts and tests import. Lines 1119-1358.

concerns.name: CLI help index rendering
concerns.description: printResearchIndex builds the research command index text via printLines. Lines 1360-1385.

proposedSplit.contents: Keep only the contract (ResearchCommandServiceShape), tag (ResearchCommandService), ResearchCommandServiceRequirements, makeResearchCommandService, ResearchCommandServiceLive, plus the eight thin use-case wrappers and the resolveResearchVaultRoot alias so the public facade and its $I tag key are untouched. Impls are imported from internal/ (~450 LOC with JSDoc).

Earned render role: printResearchIndex, wikilinkFor, and the pure markdown body builders (history stub body, clone/star repo card bodies, notion x-post body, digest note lines). index.ts must add `export * from "./Research.render.js"` so Research.command.ts keeps importing printResearchIndex from the facade.

Catalog persistence orbit next to existing internal/Catalog.ts: catalogDbPath, CardPersistRow, persistCards, loadSeenUrls plus the private row schemas SeenUrlRow, PendingCardRow, DigestCardRow and their decoders (alternatively fold into internal/Catalog.ts, which already owns the SQL constants and runWithResearchDb).
scrapeMarkdown, documentMarkdown, documentTitle, and captureUrlImpl — the Firecrawl-backed capture pipeline.

SiftCandidate, SiftCollection, collectSiftRow, historyStubCard frontmatter assembly, decodeHistorySiftSummary, and historySiftImpl; pairs with existing internal/BrowserHistory.ts which stays the raw history reader.

RepoCardCollection, collectCloneCards, collectStarCards, decodeRepoCardSummary, repoCardImpl; named *Run to avoid colliding with existing internal/RepoCards.ts (discoverClones/inspectClone/listStarredRepos).
notionPullImpl and decodeNotionPullSummary; the Notion API client stays in existing internal/NotionPull.ts.
CognifyUpload, COGNEE_ADD_BATCH_SIZE, decodeCognifySummary, cognifyImpl (batching, dataset grouping, catalog stamping, postResearchEpisode call); pairs with existing internal/CogneeClient.ts.
digestImpl and decodeDigestSummary; digest line rendering delegates to Research.render.ts, digest row queries use CatalogOps.

commitVault (git ChildProcess runner) plus dailyImpl and decodeDailySummary; imports historySiftImpl/notionPullImpl/cognifyImpl/digestImpl directly from sibling internal modules, never through the service tag, so no service↔internal cycle.
statusImpl and decodeStatusSummary — pure catalog-count queries plus the no-catalog fast path.

sharedCandidates.description: ChildProcess-based git runner with exit-code filterOrFail and staged-diff check; only the commit message and cwd are Research-specific. Same spawn-git-and-check pattern is hand-rolled in at least six other files.

The `S.decodeUnknownEffect(X)(value).pipe(<GroupError>.mapError(msg))` pattern repeats 10+ times here and in siblings (Corpus.service.ts has 16 S.decodeUnknownEffect uses, Files.service.ts 5). A shared `decodeOrFail(schema, toError)` in src/internal/cli would collapse all of them.

Generic 'use the service from context if provided, otherwise build its default layer scoped' combinator — nothing Firecrawl-specific about the shape. Useful for any command wanting test-overridable optional integrations.
alsoUsefulFor: any group with an optional external-service layer

sharedCandidates.description: Already extracted locally, but the same unknown-record guard is reinvented as isReadonlyUnknownRecord in TsconfigSync.command.ts:1099 and decodeUnknownRecordOption in Quality.command.ts:69 / FallowQuality.command.ts:82 — promote to src/internal (or reuse a @beep/schema UnknownRecord guard).

Extract markdown and metadata.title from an untyped FirecrawlScrapeSuccess.data; this is really a typed-document concern that belongs in @beep/firecrawl (a schema for the scrape document) rather than CLI-side Option gymnastics.

risks: Facade breakage: index.ts does `export *` from the four role files only; Research.command.ts and test/research-command.test.ts import printResearchIndex, the eight use-case wrappers, ResearchCommandServiceLive, and ResearchCommandService via `@beep/repo-cli/commands/Research`. Any symbol moved to Research.render.ts (or elsewhere public) needs a matching index.ts export; internal/ moves must keep the wrappers re-exported from service.ts.

$I identity drift: `$RepoCliId.create("commands/Research/Research.service")` feeds the Context.Service tag key and the S.Class identities of SeenUrlRow/PendingCardRow/DigestCardRow; moving those classes to internal/CatalogOps.ts changes their schema identifiers/annotations, and the service tag must stay in Research.service.ts to keep its key stable.

Circularity: dailyImpl invokes historySiftImpl/notionPullImpl/cognifyImpl/digestImpl/commitVault directly (not via the service); the split must keep impl modules importing each other and the service importing impls one-way, or a service↔internal import cycle appears.

Docgen/JSDoc gates: every public export carries @example blocks compiled by docgen and the tooling family crispening ratchet is blocking; new role/internal files need @packageDocumentation, @since/@category, and valid examples or `bun run docgen` and lint lanes fail.

Behavioral ordering: persistCards writes cards to disk before inserting seen-url/card/capture-log rows in one DB session, and dryRun/cardsPushed===0 short-circuits in cognifyImpl skip login; tests assert catalog rows and card contents, so extraction must not reorder writes or hoist cogneeLogin.

Mutable accumulators cross seams: SiftCollection and RepoCardCollection are mutated by collector helpers (Effect.fnUntraced) called from the impls; splitting collectors and impls into different files must preserve the shared-mutation contract and Effect.fn trace names used for spans.
